name: RADIOTHERAPY_COURSES
description: This table contains the IDs of the radiotherapy course summaries linked to the episode.

columns.name: SUMMARY_BLOCK_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the episode record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: RT_COURSE_ERT_SUMMARY_ID
columns.description: Stores the radiotherapy course summaries that were treated as part of the episode.
